HYPE.thesis: Strong value capture, but first recorded discovery occurred near an all-time high after a large repricing.
HYPE.invalidation: Value capture weakens materially or crowding/supply overwhelms demand.

UNI.thesis: Protocol value-capture thesis is real, but first recorded Hunter discovery followed a very large 30D repricing.
UNI.invalidation: Fee/burn value capture weakens or spot demand fails.

ARB.thesis: Strong repricing and volume require research, but first Hunter discovery was after a sharp multi-day move.
ARB.invalidation: Activity/revenue thesis fails or supply pressure dominates.

NEAR.thesis: Strong market move merits post-move research, but slow non-price confirmation is incomplete.
NEAR.invalidation: Relative strength/spot demand fades without corroborating non-price evidence.

ASTER.thesis: 99% of daily platform fees programmatically buy back ASTER while an equal reserve amount is burned; the 400M team allocation cliff was extended by 12 months to Sep 2027, reducing near-term dilution before a large price repricing.
ASTER.invalidation: Fee-funded buybacks materially weaken, delayed team vesting is reversed, emissions overwhelm burns, or platform activity/revenue deteriorates materially.
ASTER.stage_correction_reason: Post-discovery evidence review: Sep tokenomics catalyst had already produced material price pulses before first Hunter discovery; current stage corrected prospectively without rewriting immutable first-discovery event.

JTO.thesis: JTX creates a new fee stream where 80% of platform fees flow to the DAO and the DAO share is committed to JTO open-market buyback and burn through Q4 2027; price has not materially repriced over the last month.
JTO.invalidation: JTX fails to generate material fees/volume, buyback commitment changes, or upcoming insider/investor unlock pressure dominates value capture.
JTO.evidence_correction: JTX buyback catalyst had already repriced to ~0.63 in Jul-2026 then faded below discovery price; treat as FAILED_REPRICING evidence, not '30D no repricing'.

process_review.reason: PRE_MOVE discovery did not reach first-tranche proposal before subsequent repricing because process/SHADOW coupling blocked proposal formation.

ENA.thesis: Fee-switch governance passed and early-investor supply overhang was restructured; first Hunter encounter followed ~80% 30D repricing, so discovery quality is late, but historical appreciation is not a capital hard reject under the corrected SSOT.
ENA.invalidation: USDe growth fails to approach activation thresholds, approved value capture is not implemented, supply pressure overwhelms demand, or prospective TASK5 forward-upside/risk gates fail.

validation_state.quarantine_rule: V1 market-data score may not promote a candidate to executable BUY/ADD. Existing candidates remain research/watch evidence only.
validation_state.anti_overfit_rule: Do not tune V1 on the already-opened 2024/2025 OOS windows and relabel it validated.
validation_state.v2_objective: Prospective BTC-relative remaining-upside discovery using causal non-price evidence plus valuation/dilution/liquidity/risk; prior price appreciation is a risk/valuation input, not an automatic rejection.
validation_state.v2_validation: Forward-only shadow observations; no capital authority until independent evidence demonstrates positive BTC-relative incremental value.
